articles.title: Crypto greed gauge hits highest since just before October’s $19 billion wipeout
articles.snippet: The Fear & Greed Index reached 74 on Tuesday after sitting at 27 less than two weeks ago, showing how quickly traders have gone from caution to chasing risk.

articles.title: Chainalysis estimates $457B in taxable crypto activity, says CARF misses most
articles.snippet: The blockchain analytics firm said just 14% of the onchain activity it identified is covered by the OECD’s international crypto tax-reporting framework.

articles.title: Solana Treasury Firm Invites Investors to Look 'Beyond the Price of SOL'
articles.snippet: Nasdaq-listed SOL treasury company DeFi Development Corp launched a free network dashboard on Wednesday. Its pitch: judge Solana on more than just price.

articles.title: XRP Hot Streak Cools as Traders Hit a Wall: Where Does It Go Next?
articles.snippet: XRP has given back two days of gains after a vertical recovery, and the charts say the bounce just met a wall.

articles.title: These Researchers Just Shrunk an AI Model and Somehow Made It Smarter
articles.snippet: A smaller, cheaper AI usually means a dumber one. A new technique flipped that—and your phone might be the winner.
